remarks: Welcome home! Nestle up with a coffee in the light-drenched sunporch, which also provides an inviting entry to this fully updated Darien colonial. The open floor plan allows for casual and seamless entertaining with a large gathering room that flows easily into the dining area and adjacent kitchen with quartz counters and stainless steel appliances. A 1st floor office (or 4th bedroom) offers flexible living and is adjacent to an on-trend, full bath and mudroom with stackable laundry. On .33 acres, the backyard is flat, expansive and private with a large patio for alfresco dining, playground area and a fire pit for cozy evenings with s'mores and friends. On the 2nd floor, there are 2 bedrooms which share a full bath and a new primary suite with high ceilings, walk-in closet with 2nd laundry, and a spa-like bath. The basement was finished in '23 and houses an ample playroom/den, storage and a charming stone cellar for a future wine collection. The extensive list of updates include new windows, siding, roof, and waterproofing by CT Basements. This fantastic location is close to the train, shopping, library, town beaches and all Darien amenities, including the 'Hecker Woods' walking trails. Detached 2 car garage, with it's own attic! Come see this gem today.
